name: k3-plugin-cc
description: UNOFFICIAL BRILIA fork of linxule/kimi-plugin-cc that supports Windows: the safety hook launches under cmd.exe, setup needs no path override, and the shell probe really runs. Use Kimi K3 from Claude Code through your own Kimi Code subscription. Not affiliated with Moonshot AI. Not published to npm.

scripts.check: bun run build && bun run check:surfaces && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test && git diff --exit-code -- dist plugins/k3-codex && UNTRACKED="$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist plugins/k3-codex)" && { [ -z "$UNTRACKED" ] || { echo "drift gate: untracked dist/codex files (stage them and re-run check):"; echo "$UNTRACKED"; exit 1; }; }
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/vendor/shell-quote dist/vendor/smol-toml && cp runtime/vendor/shell-quote/LICENSE dist/vendor/shell-quote/LICENSE && cp runtime/vendor/smol-toml/*.js runtime/vendor/smol-toml/LICENSE dist/vendor/smol-toml/ && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json

author: Xule Lin
